question: Which financial events notify whom (approval pending, payment failure, reconciliation exception, mandate expiry)?
decision: Approval pending: the approver. Payment failure: treasurer. Reconciliation exception: treasurer and trustees. Mandate expiry: holder and issuer, 14 days before.
originalProposedDecision: Approval pending: the approver. Payment failure: treasurer. Reconciliation exception: treasurer and trustees. Mandate expiry: holder and issuer, 14 days before.
